summary: Iteration 3 testing: Backend 28/28 pytest passes (10 legacy + 18 new iteration-3). Frontend smoke tested thoroughly. Two frontend gaps found: (1) Inventory page is missing the required 'Générer' inline barcode button (data-testid generate-barcode-inline-{id}) in the Code-barres cell for products without barcode; (2) Scanner page exposes data-testid='scan-input' but no HTML id='scan-input' (review asks for #scan-input selector). All other checkpoints — rebrand, hotkeys S/I/C/A, nav layout (no Commandes), /commander, /etiquettes, /alertes, /scanner, ManualMovementDialog, column order, brand link home, no 'Valeur du stock' pill, dashboard top_consumed, generate-barcode API idempotency & OS-XXX scan — all verified working.

ui_bugs.issue: For products WITHOUT a barcode, the Code-barres cell just renders '—' — the 'Générer' inline button with data-testid 'generate-barcode-inline-{id}' is missing. Review requirement: 'for products WITHOUT barcode, the Code-barres cell shows a Générer button (data-testid generate-barcode-inline-{id}) that on click creates OS-XXX code, updates the row, shows toast'. Backend endpoint POST /api/products/{id}/generate-barcode is implemented and verified, only UI wiring missing.

Review mentions '#scan-input' CSS id selector but the input has only data-testid='scan-input' (no HTML id attribute). Works when selecting via [data-testid=...] but breaks any #scan-input selector usage.

action_items: Add inline 'Générer' button in Inventory.jsx Code-barres TableCell when !p.barcode, with data-testid='generate-barcode-inline-{p.id}', calling POST /api/products/{id}/generate-barcode then refreshing the row and showing a toast.
(Optional) add id='scan-input' attribute to the scan input in Scanner.jsx to satisfy literal #scan-input selector usage.
(Cleanup) /app/frontend/src/pages/Orders.jsx still exists on disk — nav link is removed and new Reorder.jsx replaces it, but the legacy file can be deleted to reduce dead code.

(Cleanup) Backend still has /api/orders and /api/reorder/auto which call reorder_suggestions(payload.horizon_days) but that function no longer accepts horizon_days — calling POST /api/reorder/auto would raise TypeError. Either drop the endpoint or update the signature. Not currently exposed in UI after iteration 3.
critical_code_review_comments: reorder_auto endpoint (server.py:609) calls reorder_suggestions(payload.horizon_days) but reorder_suggestions no longer takes any args after iteration 3 — will raise TypeError at runtime. Since the UI no longer exposes 'Générer les commandes', the endpoint is unreachable but should be removed or fixed.
server.py is 787 lines; still a candidate for splitting into routers.

Both list_products(with_usage=true) and reorder/suggestions enrich each product with an individual _compute_usage Mongo query (N+1). Fine for 10 products, but should be collapsed to a single aggregation pipeline grouping movements by product_id once catalogue grows.
Legacy /app/frontend/src/pages/Orders.jsx is orphan code — dead file after /commander replacement.

generate-barcode uses secrets.token_hex(3) (6 hex chars) — OS-XXXXXX. 16M keyspace, probability of collision at 10k products is still small but a uniqueness retry loop of 20 is a good safety net; consider a DB unique index on barcode to harden against races.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True — browsers disallow credentials with wildcard; fine today because no auth but note for Electron packaging.
